database.name: Jasne
database.vector_index: knowledge_chunks.embedding uses HNSW (vector_cosine_ops) as of 0019; the old ivfflat index from 0001 was trained on an empty table and is gone. HNSW needs no REINDEX after loading more knowledge.

storage.path_policy: object paths must start with the authenticated user id

render_healthcheck.purpose: cheap liveness only; does not call Supabase or OpenAI

deep_health.purpose: readiness check for Supabase and OpenAI; intended for external monitors, not platform restart healthchecks

system.purpose: Supabase + OpenAI + Azure DI readiness; now secret-gated to stop unauthenticated amplification (uptime.yml + UptimeRobot must send the header)

profile.purpose: profile plus deletion_status so mobile can show restore gate

profile.note: plan is owned by RevenueCat and is not user-updatable; rejected while account deletion is pending

profile.purpose: restore account during the 7-day deletion grace period
schedule account deletion with 7-day restore window; data is purged later by /internal/accounts/purge-deleted

scans.rate_limit: per-user scan-attempt limit (~20/hour, counts failed attempts too) → 429 'Too many scan attempts'; quota is charged atomically at save time so 402 can also arrive late
scans.idempotency: accepts optional Idempotency-Key header: a retry with the same key returns the original scan instead of redoing the paid pipeline; 409 if a scan with that key is still in flight

scans.purpose: SSE scan progress with keep-alive heartbeats
scans.rate_limit: same 429 attempt limit; a late 402 or generic failure arrives as an SSE error frame (raw exception text is no longer leaked)

scans.purpose: paginated scan list via list_scans_with_activity RPC
scans.response_contract_change_2026_06_13: now returns an envelope { scans: ScanListItem[], plan, archive_limit, hidden_count } instead of a bare array. Free is capped to the most-recent archive_limit (5); hidden_count is how many older scans are gated behind Pro. FRONTEND MUST read response.scans (not the top-level array) and can render the '+N hidden, upgrade' paywall from hidden_count.

scans.purpose: total and per-category counts for filter chips
signed file URLs; can render PDF previews
bulk delete scans/messages/deadlines without resetting usage quota
delete one scan; cascades messages and linked deadlines

limits.purpose: also returns chat usage for that scan

status.purpose: OAMP/IPC case status lookup through Playwright

internal.purpose: fetch Expo push receipts ~20min after send and disable DeviceNotRegistered tokens (new 2026-06-13)
permanently purge accounts whose 7-day deletion grace period elapsed

scan_pipeline: enforce per-user scan-attempt rate limit (429 if exceeded)

sign image URLs; PDFs are sent to Azure DI WHOLE as one data:application/pdf URL (prebuilt-read OCRs all pages in one call) — PyMuPDF now only counts pages on the scan path, rasterising is reserved for /image-urls previews
advisory plan-quota pre-check after final page count is known
Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt-read OCR (one shared client, bounded concurrency, per-call timeout from azure_document_intelligence_timeout_seconds)
pgvector RAG retrieval (vector query embeds only the first ~2 pages; keyword search uses full text)
category-routed analyzer (deadlines validated before streaming; relative deadlines surfaced as a manual-reminder tip)
atomic quota charge via try_increment_scan_count (authoritative gate; 402 here on a race loser) BEFORE persisting
best-effort auto-deadlines and chat thread seed

streaming_scan.heartbeats: SSE comments every 10 seconds during blocking calls
streaming_scan.deadlines_stream_note: deadlines are EXCLUDED from incremental field events and only emitted (validated) at the end before done, so a hallucinated/past date never flashes in the UI mid-stream

chat.context: scan OCR/result, message history, and RAG snippets

oamp_status.implementation: Playwright Chromium in a worker thread
oamp_status.supported: proceedings fields / formatted OAM case number / visa application number (ŽOV)
oamp_status.case_number_regex: OAMP_CASE_RE in schemas is the single source of truth; the tracker imports it so /status/oamp and 'track this case' accept identical identifiers including suffixed forms like OAM-19391-4/ZM-2026 (was a 422 mismatch before 2026-06-13)
oamp_status.unknown_outcome: unrecognized portal result text now classifies as 'unknown', not 'rejected' — a wording change on the IPC site no longer scares users with a false zamítnutí
oamp_status.playwright_note: Playwright Chromium cold-start is expensive per check. A documented research spike (DevTools network capture of the public lookup) could replace it with an httpx call, but the endpoint is behind a WordPress+React nonce-middleware and was NOT trivially extractable from static JS — deferred, not done.

help.content_model: categories and UI strings from YAML; published guides from Postgres help_guides
help.snapshot_cache: the per-request full help_guides fetch is now behind a 60s in-memory TTL cache (invalidate_snapshot_cache() drops it for admin writes/tests)

push_notifications.send_job: POST /internal/notifications/due — daily cron (7:00 UTC ≈ 8/9:00 Prague); reminder_day computed against Europe/Prague, NOT UTC, so a late-night UTC run no longer shifts/duplicates the Free 1-day reminder
push_notifications.receipts_job: POST /internal/notifications/receipts — cron at 7:45 UTC; fetches Expo receipts ~20min after send and disables DeviceNotRegistered tokens (an 'ok' ticket does not prove delivery)
push_notifications.token_lookup: push_tokens cached per cron run (no N+1); accounts in deletion grace period are skipped via deletion_status filter

account_deletion.delete_profile: DELETE /profile now marks profiles.deletion_status=pending, sets deletion_requested_at/deletion_scheduled_at/deletion_reason, clears expo_push_token, and leaves user data intact for 7 days.
account_deletion.normal_api_guard: get_active_user_id blocks normal app endpoints with 403 detail.code=account_pending_deletion while pending. /profile and /profile/restore remain available.
account_deletion.restore: POST /profile/restore clears deletion fields and returns ProfileResponse.
account_deletion.final_purge: POST /internal/accounts/purge-deleted deletes due pending accounts after the grace period: RevenueCat subscriber best-effort, storage best-effort, push_tokens/deadlines/trackings/usage_limits/scans/profile rows, and Supabase Auth identity.

pro.usage_period: subscription period derived from RevenueCat expiration when available

plan_limits.archive_limit_note: Free archive cap is now enforced (2026-06-13): GET /scans returns only the most-recent 5 for Free and reports hidden_count for the upgrade paywall. Pro is unlimited. scan_attempts_per_hour is the cost-abuse rate limit on scan attempts regardless of plan.

rpc_functions: try_increment_scan_count(p_user_id, p_month, p_cap) — conditional increment, returns new count or -1 at cap; authoritative scan-quota gate (0017)
try_increment_chat_count(p_user_id, p_month, p_scan_id, p_cap) — conditional per-scan chat increment (0017)
important_constraints: usage_limits.month accepts YYYY-MM and pro:start:end subscription-period keys
scan_messages.seq is a monotonic identity column (0016); chat reads order by seq so a Q/A pair sharing created_at can no longer flip
deadlines.scan_id is ON DELETE SET NULL again (0018); a BEFORE DELETE trigger on scans removes only auto_created deadlines, so manually created reminders survive scan deletion with scan_id nulled
bulk scan delete does not reset usage_limits after migration 0009
quota check-then-increment race is closed (0017): check_* are advisory pre-checks, try_increment_* are the atomic authoritative gate
profiles.deletion_status accepts active/pending; profiles_pending_deletion_idx accelerates purge lookup by deletion_scheduled_at

Section-1 critical fixes (committed acb5c17): deterministic chat order via scan_messages.seq; deadlines never streamed before validation; no pushes to pending-deletion accounts; OAMP 'unknown' outcome; OAMP suffixed case numbers; bounded translation length; rescued written-out/relative deadlines + expanded smlouvy keywords

Section-2 hardening (working tree, uncommitted): atomic conditional quota RPCs closing the check-then-increment race; per-user scan-attempt rate limit (429); QuotaExceededError + generic ValueError so internal errors don't leak; /health/deep behind X-Cron-Secret; _ensure_profile upsert race fix; manual deadlines survive scan delete (auto-only cascade trigger)

Section-3 performance (working tree, uncommitted): OCR rewrite (whole-PDF single Azure call, shared client, live timeout, bounded fan-out); push receipts cron + Prague-timezone reminder dates + per-run token cache; HNSW vector index; help snapshot 60s TTL cache; RAG vector query truncated to first ~2 pages

Section-4 spec sync + dead-code cleanup (working tree, uncommitted): enforce Free archive cap (GET /scans envelope with hidden_count); removed dead min_ocr_confidence config + render.yaml env; classifier max tokens 8000→500 (Vision-era artifact); fixed Vision-legacy comments; documented rag_similarity_threshold 0.50 vs stale 0.65 spec and intentional absence of deadline source_text; renamed misleading tracking-limit test to follow MAX_ACTIVE_TRACKINGS_PER_TYPE

Section-5 improvements: structured OpenAI token-usage logging (jasne.token_usage, incl. streamed calls via stream_options); Idempotency-Key on POST /scans + /scans/stream (in-memory TTL store, replay returns original scan, 409 on in-flight dup); env-gated Sentry with request_id tag + SSE-pipeline capture; FakeSupabase no longer guarantees insert-order on unordered selects so ordering regressions surface

Section-5.1 guardrail registry: ANALYSIS_GUARDRAILS (condition + per-field transforms) drives both the batch and stream-preview post-processing paths from one source; fixes the latent batch/stream divergence and pins it with a parity test
